venues.name: AKIBA FUKUROU
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0022 東京都千代田区神田練塀町６７
venues.verdict: The most magical animal cafe experience in all of Akihabara — interact with real owls in a serene, beautifully lit space.

venues.name: Maidreamin
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0021 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Sotokanda, 3-chōme−16−１７ 住吉ビル 6階
venues.verdict: The biggest and most tourist-friendly maid cafe chain — perfect for first-timers who want the full maid cafe experience without the awkwardness.

venues.name: @home cafe (あっとほぉーむカフェ)
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0021 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Sotokanda, 1-chōme−11−４ Mitsuwa Building, 3-7F
venues.verdict: One of Akihabara's longest-running maid cafes with a more authentic, less commercialized vibe than the big chains.

venues.name: Cure Maid Café
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0021 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Sotokanda, 1-chōme−2−７ 4F 本店
venues.verdict: The OG maid cafe — opened in 2001, this is where the entire concept began. Victorian fantasy vibes with genuinely good tea.

venues.name: Cat Cafe MOCHA
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0021 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Sotokanda, 4-chōme−4−３ 秋葉原Silビル 2階
venues.verdict: The most well-maintained cat cafe in Akihabara — clean, spacious, and the cats are genuinely friendly and well-socialized.

venues.name: Akibarium (アキバリウム)
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0022 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Kanda Neribeichō, 70番地 2nd Yokoshima Building, 3階
venues.verdict: One of Akihabara's largest and most elaborate concept cafes — themed around angels and fallen angels with an upscale, otherworldly atmosphere.

venues.name: Magical Lollipop (マジカルロリポップ)
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0021 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Sotokanda, 4-chōme−2−７ TIT秋葉原 3階
venues.verdict: A magic school-themed maid cafe where you're the 'hero' and apprentice witch maids cast spells on your food — wildly popular and endlessly charming.

venues.name: Like a Doll by EATME
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0021 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Sotokanda, 1-chōme−1−１０ パセラリゾーツAKIBAマルチエンターテインメント2F
venues.verdict: A dreamlike dollhouse-themed cafe produced by fashion brand EATME — black and pink interiors create a surreal, otherworldly atmosphere.

venues.name: Final Fantasy Eorzea Cafe
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0021 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Sotokanda, 1-chōme−1−１０ パセラリゾーツＡＫＩＢＡマルチエンターテインメント１Ｆ
venues.verdict: A fully immersive Final Fantasy XIV dining experience — themed dishes, character drinks, and game-accurate decor that'll make any FF fan lose their mind.

venues.name: LUIDA'S BAR (ルイーダの酒場)
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0021 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Sotokanda, 1-chōme−8−３ 野水ビル 3階
venues.verdict: The official Dragon Quest bar — themed cocktails, slime-shaped desserts, and a tavern atmosphere straight out of the game series.

venues.name: Queen's Court (女神の中庭)
venues.address: Japan, 〒101-0021 Tokyo, Chiyoda City, Sotokanda, 3-chōme−6−２ Fh協和スクエア
venues.verdict: A beautifully designed kingdom-themed cafe with casino-inspired interiors, arc-shaped open kitchen, and maids cooking in full view.

venues.name: Cafe Mai:lish (メイリッシュ)
venues.verdict: The real-life inspiration for May Queen Nyan-Nyan from Steins;Gate — a pilgrimage site for anime fans that's also a genuinely charming maid cafe.
